title: PregOutfit 솔로 #118 · 임산부슈퍼글래머 · 소방관 · glossy soft-coral lips
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Vietnamese woman, an adult, in her mid 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 studs piercings set with pearls in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal earrings. Wearing a minimal firefighter costume of a tiny black top of two small opaque cups with two silver reflective stripes, a black low-rise micro-mini skirt with a silver reflective stripe and its hem at the very top of her thighs, a wide yellow belt with a silver buckle worn low on her hips and a red firefighter helmet, fully opaque and covering only what it must, the bottom worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme black extreme platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
